Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Actively involved in engineering discussions. Ability to pro-actively communicate clearly, both orally and in writing in order to be actively involved in cross-functional discussions.

- Experience creating and maintaining BOMs, mechanical drawings, and assembly/process documentation.
- Exposure working with vendors for custom components and sourcing specific hardware for designs.

- Typically requires 2-4+ years of mechanical product/design engineering experience or relevant technical experience. Experience with 3D CAD system preferably SolidWorks or equivalent.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

In your role as Process Engineer, you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory. You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process optimization and further development of reactor hardware. In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes coompley test series with development projects
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribtuion to ensuring our customers' rapid success

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment
- You have good written and spoken English skills
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%)

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON

Global Commodity Manager Valves & Actuators

Job Title  Corporate Commodity Manager (f/m/d) Valves & Actuators Location: Germany, Sweden, US Department: SE P DM SYS RA Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis Mode of Employment: Full-time / Permanent A Snapshot of Your Day  The organization Strategic Procurement, Direct Material is responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies for direct materials and services that will ensure the optimization of Siemens Energy’s competitive position. As a Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, you will be part of Corporate Strategic Procurement team (SE P DM SYS RA), lead a cross-functional team globally and are responsible for a Corporate commodity strategy. Focus is on developing and managing a Valves & Actuator suppliers Typical day for Corporate Commodity Manager includes define/execution of commodity strategies, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, supplier contract management, reporting, problem solving and escalation handling, supply chain risk mitigation as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact  The successful candidate will be the Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, which includes: Manage commodity globally and across organizations and develop, implement, and maintain a global commodity strategy for Valves & Actuators, in alignment with business units. Conduct market analysis, cost structure analysis, and supply landscape evaluations. Identify cost‑saving opportunities, to include innovation pathways Maintain a strong external network of Valve & Actuator OEM’s, which include new supplier development. Identify, evaluate, and approve strategic suppliers based on capability, sustainability, quality, and cost. Build long‑term supplier relationships and lead supplier business reviews, scorecard evaluations, and follow-up actions. Ensure business continuity by preparing risk mitigation plans and dual/multi sourcing concepts. Internal and external management around demand vs supply in terms of capacity management. Internal and external management around market intelligence, which includes but is not limited to Market trends (cost drivers, M&A, demand). Geopolitical and supply chain risk impact, competitor and supplier landscape. Prepare and run quarterly business reviews / executive alignment Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing, terms, capacity and service agreements and manage framework contracts, SLAs, pricing and supply agreements. Ensure suppliers meet environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards. Be strong interface to lead commodity circles with R&D, Cost-Value Engineering, Supplier Quality Development as well as other procurement functions. What You Bring Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related field. 5–10 years’ experience in strategic procurement, preferably in Direct Materials in Energy, Oil & Gas, Process Industry. Packaging experience is strongly preferred. Strong commercial and negotiation skills. Knowledge in supply and supplier markets for Valves & Actuators. Operations experience (Manufacturing and SCM), ideally in a leadership position are a plus Excellent analytical capabilities and structured problem-solving. Strong stakeholder management capabilities across functions and regions. Ability to integrate and influence in a matrix organization and drive corporate initiatives Excellent knowledge of contract law and export control Knowledge in geo-political cost management strategies Fluent English; German and other languages are a plus Position is posted for Germany, Sweden, US Travel percentage ~25%   About the Team The SE P DM SYS RA organization is responsible for managing 3rd party spend as well as developing procurement strategies of direct material fields for Rotating Equipment and Auxiliaries that will allow Siemens Energy to maintain competitive position in marketplace and support company’s vision to become the most valued energy technology company Our professional procurement team utilizes modern tools and processes to develop global sourcing strategy for assigned commodities, that delivers optimal supply cost, quality, on time delivery, ESG (Environment, Social & Governance) compliant and VUCA resilient supply chain for Business Unit to improve competitive advantage for Siemens Energy.

Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. With pizza, cake, and desserts, as well as digital platforms and services - quality and an innovative spirit set us apart.

What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?

JOIN THE TASTE.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- As Project Manager (m/f/d) Reporting and Analytics, you will be responsible for the sustainable transformation of reporting through the implementation of a comprehensive project portfolio. You will play an active role in shaping the future vision for reporting, including its underlying processes and architecture.
- You will lead the redesign of management reporting in direct collaboration with relevant stakeholders. In doing so, you will work closely with international executive management, local subsidiaries, and international functions.
- In addition, you will translate business requirements into viable and pragmatic solutions. You will ensure that business and technical requirements are effectively aligned.
- You will independently manage and coordinate interdisciplinary teams from both the business and IT functions. You will also contribute to decision-making processes and facilitate alignment among senior stakeholders.
- Together with relevant stakeholders, you will continuously refine reporting processes and systems. You will ensure the sustainable improvement of existing structures and ways of working.
- In addition, you will be responsible for designing and implementing communication, change management, and training initiatives in an international setting. You will support the transformation through target group-specific formats and initiatives.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have a degree in business administration or a comparable qualification. Ideally, you have a background in controlling or finance.
- You have several years of professional experience in controlling, reporting, or similar roles. In addition, you have successfully worked on and/or led complex, cross-functional, and international projects over multiple years.
- You are highly proficient in reporting, consolidation, and data processes. You are experienced in working with modern BI and analytics platforms such as SAP Datasphere, SAC, or Databricks.
- You stand out for your structured, analytical, and solution-oriented approach to work. Your strong sense of pragmatism helps you develop viable solutions.
- In addition, you are motivated to actively drive and support transformation initiatives. You also bring a strong sense of ownership, a results-oriented mindset, and team spirit to an international environment.
- You are a strong communicator who can convey complex topics effectively to a wide range of stakeholders.
- You have excellent German and English language skills. Furthermore, you are willing to travel internationally.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

- Attractive remuneration
- Flexible work models & mobile work
- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve
- Onboarding and professional development opportunities
- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop
- Events and celebrations
- Sports, health and fitness offers
- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services
- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service
